item_name: Rothco Fast Action First Aid Tourniquet Pouch
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Fast Action First Aid Tourniquet Pouch is designed for rapid access to first-aid gear in situations where every second counts. The exterior pocket secures your tourniquet with a webbing flap featuring a hook and loop closure and elasticized polyester for a secure fit. The fast action pull tab allows easy one-handed access for self-use. The inside of the back flap features a convenient elastic band for storing your medical shears, while the inside of the front flap boasts two pockets with elastic trim for first-aid storage.
description: Rothco’s Fast Action First Aid Tourniquet Pouch is designed for rapid access to first-aid gear in situations where every second counts. The exterior pocket secures yourtourniquet with a webbing flap featuring a hook and loop closure and elasticized polyester for a secure fit. The fast action pull tab is designed to allow easy one-handed access – perfect for self-use in an emergency situation. The inside of the back flap features a convenient elastic band for storing your medical shears, while the inside of the front flap boasts two pockets with elastic trim for additional first-aid storage. The U-shaped opening allows for full access to the contents of the pouch, making it easy to find what you need in a hurry. The water-resistant polyester composition helps keep your supplies safe and dry, while the MOLLE compatible design means you can attach it to anything with a MOLLE panel.
